==============================================================================
I. Tilt of a piece: reflection and transmission
==============================================================================
  tilt 0.10 deg: reflected ray turns 0.20 deg; transmitted image shift 0.011 px (t=18px)
  tilt 0.25 deg: reflected ray turns 0.50 deg; transmitted image shift 0.027 px (t=18px)
  tilt 0.50 deg: reflected ray turns 1.00 deg; transmitted image shift 0.054 px (t=18px)
  tilt 1.00 deg: reflected ray turns 2.00 deg; transmitted image shift 0.107 px (t=18px)
  tilt 2.00 deg: reflected ray turns 4.00 deg; transmitted image shift 0.215 px (t=18px)
  tilt 4.00 deg: reflected ray turns 8.00 deg; transmitted image shift 0.430 px (t=18px)
  at 0.6 m from a 96-dpi screen 1 deg of view = 40 CSS px; so a 0.5 deg tilt moves a distant reflection ~40 px
  lamp 50 px above the pane: a 1 deg tilt moves the lamp's highlight ~1.7 px
  lamp 100 px above the pane: a 1 deg tilt moves the lamp's highlight ~3.5 px
  lamp 200 px above the pane: a 1 deg tilt moves the lamp's highlight ~7.0 px
  lamp 400 px above the pane: a 1 deg tilt moves the lamp's highlight ~14.0 px
